nodes.text:
Health experts emphasise that there is no need to panic. #HMPV, which resembles the symptoms of common cold, has been known for more than two decades, while coronavirus was a completely new virus against which nobody had immunity, they point out.  
An explainer: https://t.co/3FxS4DC7nD

nodes.text: Medical experts say that HMPV is ' like any other respiratory virus' that causes common cold & there is no need to panic. We need to keep a constant watch on pathogens & be prepared to tackle them using scientific knowledge and methods. Don't follow every day SENSEX/NIFTY 😆 https://t.co/eZPzEvFUEH
